BotRefreshTests.Name: Open long and short winners/losers reset to allocation; flat-price closes earn zero
Partial closes release only post-refresh P&L, including after checkpoint restore
A partially filled entry keeps its order and averages the new accounting basis
Scaling and reversal use independent cost bases without leaking old unrealized P&L
Working protections, stops, queued exits and retry deadlines retain identity and priority
Negative equity is recapitalized without dropping pending liquidation exposure
Retiring bots and closed markets receive no funding; players and clearing excluded
Repeat receipts are idempotent forever; deliberate later refresh creates a new baseline
Invalid allocation fails before touching any bot or market
Owner-only parsing and queued boundary reject unauthorized and duplicate callbacks
Group ownership fails closed and an unavailable world never queues a refresh
Queued chat applies at one scheduler boundary and holds the step until saving finishes
Durable commit is atomic, excludes overlaps, preserves live identity and restores exactly
Encode rejection leaves the original world untouched and runnable
Failed or ambiguous saves pause, reload the durable outcome and never double-apply

BotFairnessTests.Name: Liquidity quotes passively, retains FIFO and cannot reverse through an exit
BotFairnessTests.Detail: Entries do not pay the spread; existing quotes keep priority; inventory exits are reduce-only

BotFairnessTests.Name: Liquidity pauses before depletion and waits for real exit liquidity
BotFairnessTests.Detail: Underfunded bots reduce to flat and stay paused; only explicit restored equity permits new risk

BotFairnessTests.Name: Legacy liquidity inventory receives stops without widening existing protection
BotFairnessTests.Detail: Legacy positions gain bounded protection on a decision; tighter stops survive

BotFairnessTests.Name: Bot scale-ins and partial fills never loosen stops in either direction
BotFairnessTests.Detail: Long and short averaging-down preserves the original stop

BotFairnessTests.Name: Makers withdraw stale value risk before minimum rest and never take liquidity
BotFairnessTests.Detail: Materially stale quotes cancel immediately; replacements remain passive

BotFairnessTests.Name: Public time-weighted signal cannot see hidden fair value
BotFairnessTests.Detail: Duration weighting is exact; hidden generator changes cannot change reversal decisions

BotFairnessTests.Name: V19 upgrade preserves economic state and current format resumes deterministically
BotFairnessTests.Detail: No funding or trades at migration; exact replay retains quotes, stops, signal history and RNG

BotSignalsTests.Name: Protective public midpoint tracks up and down without stale-price bias
BotSignalsTests.Detail: A stale belief or hidden fair value cannot manufacture an entry when price equals the public midpoint

BotSignalsTests.Name: Reversion needs observed-price distance and an actual turn in both directions
BotSignalsTests.Detail: Continuations blocked; observed-price turns admitted independently of private fair value

BotSignalsTests.Name: Unconfirmed Reversion reductions cannot reverse or exceed the remaining position
BotSignalsTests.Detail: Warmup and confirmation do not block reductions; five requested contracts are capped to one

BotSignalsTests.Name: Time windows are independent of trade count, bounded, and require fresh history
BotSignalsTests.Detail: One sample per second; at most 62 samples; execution bursts cannot shorten the horizon

BotSignalsTests.Name: Scalpers admit affordable small moves but reject flat prices and poor targets
BotSignalsTests.Detail: A genuine two-tick move can trade; flat tape and inadequate target room cannot

BotSignalsTests.Name: V17 strategy migration preserves ledgers and orders; current format resumes exactly
BotSignalsTests.Detail: No deposits, withdrawals, trades or account/order changes on upgrade; exact resumed signals and RNG

BotPublicInformationTests.Name: Every trading profile and decision is independent of hidden value and future news
BotPublicInformationTests.Detail: Seven trader types initialize, observe and submit identically with opposite hidden values and future schedules

BotPublicInformationTests.Name: Trader paths cannot read private market fields even with a legacy profile
BotPublicInformationTests.Detail: Private generator fields are guarded during adoption and every strategy path

BotPublicInformationTests.Name: Public quote matches the player snapshot and falls back safely without a two-sided book
BotPublicInformationTests.Detail: The strategy and client share executable bid/ask filtering; empty sides use last trade

BotPublicInformationTests.Name: Adoption cancels private entries and parent intent while preserving inventory and exits
BotPublicInformationTests.Detail: Idempotent adoption retains cash, positions, stops and reduce-only exits without fills or random draws

BotPublicInformationTests.Name: Makers and reserves retain private valuation and are excluded from adoption
BotPublicInformationTests.Detail: Both infrastructure groups continue repricing from internal fair value

BotPublicInformationTests.Name: V20 adoption preserves economics and V21 checkpoints replay exactly
BotPublicInformationTests.Detail: Restore itself preserves state; first-step adoption is saved and exact continuation survives encode/decode
